(2) '21.9-9.95=12 cache traffic' mixes K=1 per-step with K=4 per-row; same-K subtraction (54.8-39.8) gives 15.0 ms/step for all cache-related work, of which KV bandwidth is 1.26 ms = 8%. So the wall is this box's per-call/per-kernel overhead, not attention throughput or bandwidth.
